payload.body: ic design for hv decision 53 (start and end marks): ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/marks1126/marks-note.md (167e7d47). CLI plays begin_record.caf / end_record.caf (macOS system sounds) by afplay in the background; ARNGZ_SOUNDS=off. Marks are toasts of their own (bottom right, own slot) by short hs calls; start stays until end; end from the EXIT trap on every way out: "arngz: done" for 0 and 1, "arngz: stopped: <reason>" otherwise, same falling sound. The start call is discover's first short call (T1). Sizes: ic S + S, cc XS. Code on vc's word.
